description: This file defines the 'Answer' entity for a Spring Boot application using JPA/Hibernate. It maps to the 'answers' table and includes fields such as id, text, and a relationship to a 'Question' entity. It extends an audit model for tracking creation and modification info.

classes.name: Answer
classes.description: JPA entity representing an answer, with fields for id, text, and a relationship to Question.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the answer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the answer.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the answer.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the answer.

methods.name: setQuestion
methods.description: Associates a Question object with this answer.
